title: Percona: ACL list + grant
description: Runs `nexus acl percona list` (SELECT user,host FROM mysql.user) then `nexus acl percona grant` (CREATE USER + GRANT). Galera replicates the user to all PXC nodes.

observe.what: user table: nexus-cluster-admin + smoke-rw + wsrep_sst + clustercheck

steps.command: nexus acl percona grant --user demo-reader --permissions SELECT --yes

observe.what: demo-reader created; the command re-describes the user to confirm

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.AclAsync lists mysql.user and idempotently grants via CREATE USER + GRANT (operator has GRANT OPTION).
